# Custom triggers

## Custom code event

Runs when a script, another action or a connected program fires a custom event with a name you choose. A way to chain your own actions.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Event name** | Only run for the event with this name, like "BossFight". Leave empty to run for every custom event. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%eventName%` | The name of the event that was fired |

<small>Type id: `custom.codeEvent`</small>
